name: zeffect_trace_upward_hit_from_node_or_pos
description: zEffect::TraceUpwardHitFromNodeOrPos resolves a node or explicit position, temporarily disables the source node raycast flag, casts an upward ray through cls_di, restores raycast state, and reports whether a hit was found.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this zEffect/cls_di bridge; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zEffect and zClass cls_di source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x45c530 validates the node-position path through gwNode::GetWorldPosition, explicit-position fallback, null-position error return, default ray height of 50.0f, temporary gwNodeSetRaycastable disable/restore, SetStopAfterFirstHit(0x40000), SetBreakOnFirstCandidate(1/0), upward RaycastFindClosest call using g_zEffect_World and a stack candidate buffer, outHit write from result and candidate count, and stack cleanup of the two stack arguments.

The native zEffect smoke verifies node-position and explicit-position calls against an empty world, raycastable restoration, break/stop global restoration, default-height endpoint setup, and null-position early return.
